C.domain: Subtracting fractions and mixed numbers (including regrouping and simplification)

skills.name: Common denominator conversion
skills.definition: Find a least common denominator (LCD) and rewrite one or both fractions as equivalent fractions with that denominator.
inclusion_criteria: Solution explicitly finds an LCD/LCM of denominators
Solution converts fractions to equivalent forms with a common denominator before subtracting
exclusion_criteria: Fractions already share a denominator and no conversion is performed
Only rewriting a whole number as n/n (e.g., 1 = 3/3) without an LCD step

skills.name: Subtract fraction parts
skills.definition: Compute the fractional subtraction once denominators match (including like-denominator subtraction and handling a zero numerator result).
inclusion_criteria: Subtracts numerators over a common denominator (a/b − c/b)
Performs the fraction-part subtraction within a mixed-number subtraction (e.g., 4/12 − 7/12)
exclusion_criteria: Only subtracts whole-number parts with no fractional subtraction
Only simplifies/reduces a fraction after subtraction (that is S04)

skills.name: Mixed-number regrouping
skills.definition: Rewrite or regroup whole and fractional parts to enable subtraction, including borrowing 1 from the whole part or rewriting a whole number as a mixed number with a chosen denominator.
inclusion_criteria: Borrows/regroups from the whole part because the fractional subtraction is negative (e.g., add b/b after reducing the whole by 1)
Rewrites a whole number as a mixed number with 0/b or as (k−1) + b/b to subtract a fraction
Converts mixed numbers to improper fractions as a setup for subtraction
exclusion_criteria: Only finds an LCD and converts fractions (that is S01)
Only performs the actual numerator subtraction once set up (that is S02)

skills.name: Simplify and express result
skills.definition: Reduce the final fraction to lowest terms and/or express the final value in an appropriate form (integer, proper fraction, or mixed number).
inclusion_criteria: Simplifies a fraction by dividing numerator and denominator by a common factor
Converts 0/b to 0 or otherwise expresses an integer result
Converts an improper fraction to a mixed number for the final answer
exclusion_criteria: Only performs subtraction without any reduction or form conversion
Only finds a common denominator or borrows/regroups (S01 or S03)

B.domain: Subtracting fractions and mixed numbers and simplifying results

skills.name: Common denominator conversion
skills.definition: Find a least common denominator (LCD) and rewrite one or both fractions as equivalent fractions with that denominator.
inclusion_criteria: Solution explicitly finds an LCD/LCM of denominators
Solution converts fractions to equivalent forms with a shared denominator before subtracting
exclusion_criteria: Fractions already have the same denominator and no conversion is performed
Only borrowing/regrouping within a mixed number is done without changing denominators

skills.name: Subtract aligned fractions
skills.definition: Subtract fractions once they are aligned (typically same denominator) by subtracting numerators and keeping the denominator.
inclusion_criteria: Solution performs fraction subtraction with like denominators (including after conversion)
Includes cases yielding 0 or a negative fraction result
exclusion_criteria: Only subtracts whole-number parts without any fraction subtraction
Only simplifies/reduces a fraction without performing subtraction

skills.name: Mixed/whole restructuring
skills.definition: Rewrite numbers into a convenient equivalent form for subtraction (e.g., separate whole and fraction parts, rewrite a whole number as a mixed number or fraction, or convert mixed to improper).
inclusion_criteria: Rewrites a whole number as a mixed number with a chosen denominator (e.g., 3 as 3 0/5, or 2 as 1 3/3)
Separates a mixed/improper mixed expression into whole and fractional components to set up subtraction
Converts mixed numbers to improper fractions (or vice versa) as part of setting up the subtraction
exclusion_criteria: Only finds an LCD and converts fractions (tag S01 instead)
Only performs borrowing/regrouping after a negative fractional difference appears (tag S04 instead)

skills.name: Regroup and simplify result
skills.definition: When needed, borrow/regroup between whole and fractional parts to resolve a negative fractional subtraction, then express the final answer in simplest form (reduce and/or convert to integer/mixed number).
inclusion_criteria: Borrows 1 from the whole part and adds an equivalent fraction (e.g., +12/12, +5/5) to make the fractional subtraction nonnegative
Simplifies/reduces a fraction to lowest terms (including 0/a to 0)
Converts an improper fraction result to a mixed number or recognizes an integer result
exclusion_criteria: Fraction subtraction is completed without any regrouping and no simplification/conversion is shown
Only performs common-denominator conversion (tag S01) or basic numerator subtraction (tag S02) without any regrouping/simplification step

A.domain: Subtracting fractions and mixed numbers and simplifying results

skills.name: Common denominator conversion
skills.definition: Find a least common denominator (LCD) and rewrite one or both fractions as equivalent fractions with that denominator.
inclusion_criteria: Solution explicitly finds an LCD/LCM for two denominators
Solution converts fractions (often fraction parts of mixed numbers) to equivalent forms with a common denominator before subtracting
exclusion_criteria: Fractions already share a denominator and no conversion is performed
Only rewriting a whole number as a fraction (e.g., 1 = 3/3) without computing an LCD

skills.name: Subtract fraction parts
skills.definition: Perform the fraction subtraction once denominators match (including like-denominator subtraction by subtracting numerators).
inclusion_criteria: Solution subtracts two fractions with the same denominator (after any needed conversion)
Solution shows numerator subtraction (a−b)/d or equivalent arithmetic on fraction parts
exclusion_criteria: Only subtracting whole-number parts without any fraction subtraction
Only simplifying/reducing a fraction without performing a subtraction

skills.name: Mixed/whole regrouping
skills.definition: Rewrite or regroup whole and fractional parts (including borrowing 1 as d/d or rewriting a whole number as a mixed number) to make subtraction possible when the fractional part would be negative.
inclusion_criteria: Solution rewrites a whole number as a mixed number with a chosen denominator (e.g., 3 as 3 0/5 or 2 as 1 3/3)
Solution borrows/regroups from the whole part to the fraction part (e.g., reduce whole by 1 and add d/d to the fraction)
Solution separates/combines whole and fraction parts to restructure the subtraction (e.g., 4 − (1 + 4/3) = (4−1) − 4/3)
exclusion_criteria: Straight subtraction of mixed numbers where the fractional part does not require borrowing/regrouping
Converting a mixed number to an improper fraction without any regrouping/borrowing step

skills.name: Simplify and format result
skills.definition: Reduce the final fraction to lowest terms and/or express the final answer in an appropriate form (integer, proper fraction, or mixed number).
inclusion_criteria: Solution simplifies a fraction by dividing numerator and denominator by a common factor
Solution converts 0/d to 0 or otherwise simplifies to an integer
Solution converts an improper fraction to a mixed number (or combines whole+fraction into a mixed-number final form)
exclusion_criteria: Only finding a common denominator or subtracting without any reduction or final-form conversion
Intermediate conversions that are not part of final simplification/formatting
